why: Among the sharpest long-form interview shows in English, with well-prepared conversations on politics, ideas and technology that hold up beyond the news cycle.
Critically praised and hugely popular narrative history whose multi-part series suit commutes and chores.
CommonWealth Magazine's podcast brings reported Taiwanese business and society journalism in Mandarin, not headline churn.
Plain Law Movement explains the legal and civic issues behind Taiwanese public debates with real expertise.
Froggy Chiu's long, thoughtful monologues and conversations on society and culture are among the more substantive Taiwanese chat shows.
Amy Poehler's Golden Globe-winning interview show is warm and funny, and it earns its popularity.
Taiwan's most popular podcast is an opinionated and entertaining take on markets and tech that earns its chart position.
Irreverent bilingual commentary and interviews on international affairs, more perspective than daily rundown.
Practical, well-argued discussions of work, careers and adult life from the 大人學 team.
A dependable Mandarin books show whose careful non-fiction discussions help decide what to read next.
A popular celebrity interview show where the hosts' chemistry reliably gets guests to loosen up.
Long-form Mandarin interviews with guests from business, the arts and public life, hosted with curiosity.
Accessible psychology grounded in research rather than platitudes, in an easy listening length.
A much-loved Taiwanese comedy chat show made for commuting, popular because the hosts are funny.
Brian Tseng's comedy and interview show offers sharp, sometimes provocative conversations with notable Taiwanese guests.
A practising counselling psychologist talks about relationships and family with more depth than most shows in the genre.
A chart-topping, candid society-and-culture chat show with a distinctive voice, though lighter than the reporting-led picks.
Well-made and influential political commentary, weighted low because it follows the news cycle closely.
Short, popular lessons on money and business from a veteran author, useful in small doses.
Solid, well-prepared leadership interviews with authors and coaches, one of the few business shows here with substance.
Book-driven discussions of thinking and self-improvement, a decent occasional listen.
A light, witty personal chat show from a well-known humour writer, for easy chore-time listening.
